title: Storey Architecture studio
description: A full-bleed photo band exactly 160% of the window tall. A large three-line white statement sits centred a little above the middle with a wide white button under it; two white paragraphs sit side by side at the bottom-right. The oversized photo drifts down as the band scrolls past; the copy rises in.
notes: white text over media: in light themes it uses --background; dark: swaps it for --foreground
media is 120% of the band's height so the drift never shows an edge; empty shows a stone-grey (glow) placeholder
